objective: Measure how simultaneous remote-attention requests and real KV migration interfere on one shared application transport budget and on each selected GPU; establish whether coordination improves foreground service while exposing its migration, competing-request and fairness costs.

claim_scope.full_means: Complete this declared two-host mechanism matrix, paired solo counterfactuals, accounting, diagnostics, profiles and independent review. It does not mean that a two-request pilot establishes production tails, stable queue capacity or joint SLO compliance.
claim_scope.relation_to_E1_E2_E3: E1 varies isolated action regimes with controlled same-GPU load; E2 compares continuation states; E3 changes the environment within a request. E4 holds actions and the exogenous environment fixed and changes shared-resource scheduling among genuinely concurrent requests/transfer jobs.
claim_scope.candidate_claim: A particular implemented scheduler may reduce foreground queuing under the measured bottleneck, at an explicitly measured cost to other requests and transfer progress. Negative, tied and starvation outcomes remain results.
not_novel_by_itself: RPC priority, finite transfer chunks, weighted round robin, aging, or pause/resume
Using two sockets while giving each its own full-rate budget
A faster foreground request obtained by omitting required migration work
excluded_claims: Production request p95/p99, stationary tail probabilities, or an SLO guarantee from eight paired blocks
A new scheduling optimality, stability, fairness or starvation-freedom theorem
Physical NIC bytes, wireless bandwidth, cellular contention or device mobility inferred from an application cap
Independent competing network paths, multi-holder routing or three-host interference on this two-host setup
A speedup compared with historical A800, Babel A100/L40S or SUTD cohorts
A jointly learned admission/action/placement controller; E4 fixes offered work and action semantics

required: accepted main14B E0 suite and overlap profile
accepted E1 smoke then E1 full including profiles
accepted E2 smoke then E2 full
accepted E3 smoke then E3 full
new E4 smoke bound to final E4 sources
frozen E4 full matrix and independent raw review
stage_order.historical_smoke: The old FIFO/RPC-first two-request smoke is historical functional evidence. The interrupted direct E4 smoke and any bounded pilot cannot grant this full-stage acceptance.
stage_order.scientific_source_change: New scheduling/instrumentation requires CPU component checks and main-model E4 smoke. Changes to mathematical kernels, cache ownership or attention routes additionally require the affected E0 correctness checks; accepted E0 is not transferable by a naked passed flag.

cohort.GPU_target: NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe; verify actual UUID/name/memory on each host
cohort.attention: Same accepted eager implementation and precision flags across every method
cohort.source_role: One resident model/selected GPU holds all immutable prefixes and serves all remote attention.
cohort.destination_role: One resident model/selected GPU executes all request-local computation and receives actual KV tensors.
cohort.unused_GPUs: Each VM exposes one selected physical A100 GPU; TP1 per worker, two GPUs total.
cohort.isolation: Reject unrelated GPU compute processes. Owned intentional background compute is separately identified and reported.
cohort.identity: Record actual hostname, boot ID, DMI UUID, internal IP, GPU UUID, driver, software, source/model/input/plan hashes and run IDs. No invented Slurm identity or synchronized-host-clock assumption.

shared_semantics.prefix_and_suffix: Prepare each holder immutable prefix with one complete P-token prefill before group acceptance for every method. Destination starts empty. All request suffixes are tokenwise S16, all foreground/background requests use fixed executor G64 and public cap128; the controller does not see realized G.
shared_semantics.prefix_identity: Foreground A and each competing request B1/B2/B3 use distinct frozen input identities and separate mutable delta caches; no cache-hit or shared-request-state advantage varies with method. All methods in a block reuse the identical token arrays.
shared_semantics.request_start: All offered jobs in a group exist before a common destination acceptance timestamp. Release real worker threads from one barrier after setup-independent prefix preparation; include thread dispatch, batch/control setup and waits from that timestamp. Record per-request executor entry and observed source release/ACK intervals. Do not claim simultaneous GPU execution or cross-host timestamp synchronization.
shared_semantics.bottleneck: One outgoing SharedBandwidthCoordinator per physical host covers every control, RPC and bulk stream in that direction, with one total application-byte cap. Reverse direction has its own identically configured cap. No per-request or per-socket clone gets an additional capacity budget.
shared_semantics.network_path: Same scoped experiment-port network path on both hosts with zero requested added delay. Record actual baseline RTT and verified netem state; no RTT sensitivity axis is added here.
shared_semantics.GPU_queue: Use the same FIFO ready-compute queue for every method: whole prefix/local-token operations, remote compute segments release admission during blocking RPC and rejoin after reply; transport copies are outside the compute queue. Do not hold a GPU lease while waiting for network service or change compute priority for one network method.
shared_semantics.request_settlement: A request is settled only after its final token and its own required transfers, terminal/control acknowledgements and ownership cleanup. Shared group batch_done is a group timestamp, not a substitute for each request's actual settlement. Group end waits for all offered jobs and owned background drain; both token completion and settled time are preserved.
shared_semantics.reset: After each group or solo trial, drain all owned streams/requests, release every request-local delta/prefix reference, reset target cache and scheduling state, and preserve only the declared immutable holder prefixes. No repair-retention cache hit carries between methods.
shared_semantics.persistent_engine: Keep weights, kernels and model instances resident across a session; record initialization/restarts in resource cost, exclude them from request latency. Never compare one method with a cold model to another with a warm model.

methods.scheduler: FIFO across ready socket chunks; same shared total cap
methods.role: Uncoordinated coarse-granularity baseline; not an unbounded whole-prefix write.
Isolates chunk granularity from RPC priority.

methods.scheduler: Work-conserving byte-deficit round robin with RPC:bulk weights3:1; byte quanta3Q andQ, FIFO within each class
methods.role: Strong fixed-share baseline; includes all control/RPC bytes in the RPC class. Idle capacity may be borrowed. No future queue or token knowledge.

methods.scheduler: RPC class before bulk at each finite chunk boundary; FIFO within class
methods.role: Existing activation-priority baseline and aging-removal ablation. Possible bulk starvation is measured, not concealed.

methods.scheduler: Normally RPC-first; if an eligible bulk stream has waited at least max(0.005s,4*Q*8/C), grant exactly one oldest eligible bulk chunk next, then return to RPC-first. FIFO by ticket within each class; age is from the local pending-ticket enqueue timestamp; Q=16384, C=current fixed directional cap in bit/s.
methods.role: Untrained, predeclared contention-aware candidate. Uses only actual ready queues and elapsed age. Parameters are fixed before data, not chosen to make this cohort win. This is an implementation candidate, not a novelty theorem.

In transfer-isolation cells omit the transfer-only job; in coupled cells execute every B request as remote instead of repair. Same offered decoding requests but absent target-cache retention; therefore not an equal-migration-work scheduler and excluded from transfer-completion Pareto rankings.

scheduling_contract.granularity: Finite socket chunks may split wire frames on separate connections; FIFO/priority acts only between chunks. Receiver publishes a KV layer only after its full K/V tensors and actual CUDA readiness. No half-frame cancellation or partially received layer is treated as usable cache.
scheduling_contract.costs: Grant wait, pacing wait, socket write/backpressure, frame encoding/decoding, sender/receiver CPU work and DtoH/HtoD copies remain inside the real request/group interval. No scheduler receives free out-of-budget control traffic.
scheduling_contract.scope_of_age_bound: The age threshold triggers next-selection preference only. Nonpreemptive active writes, pacing, unavailable GPU data and OS/network stalls preclude a real-time wait bound; do not report starvation freedom as proved.
scheduling_contract.byte_weighting: Charge actual requested/returned bytes and keep cancelled/partially written reservations distinct; weighted service must operate on byte deficits, not frame count. Every method uses the same framing and tensor representation.
CPU_checks_before_smoke: No aggregate over-budget credit or independent per-flow budget
Exact FIFO/class/aging order on deterministic ready queues
Partial send, blocked send, cancellation, shutdown and error propagation
Weighted service with unequal frame sizes and idle-class borrowing
No age reset that silently prevents an old bulk ticket from becoming eligible
No lock held across control receive while a worker needs that lock to finish

module_contracts.transfer_isolation: One remote request A plus a separate transfer-only immutable prefix job: actually read source GPU KV, serialize, send through the same directional budget, deserialize and publish all48 destination GPU layers. The transfer job does no model decode, separating transfer/copy/network interference from competing request compute. It is actual future-use cache materialization, not a dummy byte array. No-migration reference offers only A and has no completed transfer; its empty migration metric is null, never zero or instantaneous success.
module_contracts.coupled_requests: A remains remote for all64 tokens. B1 or B1/B2/B3 each performs actual progressive repair plus64 generated tokens under the same shared source/destination GPU queues and transport budgets. Fully received layers may naturally localize B. The no-migration reference runs each B remotely for64 tokens. This changes remote compute and retained-cache service, so report it as an interference reference, not the causal effect of network scheduling alone.
module_contracts.load: Use the accepted cached-local background implementation with P1024/S16/G32, one real producer on the selected holder or destination GPU, Poisson rho0.5 based on that host's isolated service calibration. Same input/seed and arrival recipe across methods; record actual arrivals and acceptance offsets on each local clock, not fictitious aligned arrivals. Include all offered background requests and complete drain. It is controlled co-located compute, not mobile-device emulation.
module_contracts.factorization: Four transfer-isolation cells, four coupled-request cells and four compute-load sensitivities:12 total. No added-RTT sweep, dynamic bandwidth, multi-holder path, load-by-low-rate factorial or outcome-selected extra geometry in this first E4 matrix.

solo_counterfactuals.required: For every group candidate, actually execute each decoded request alone with identical tokens, P/S/G, action, scheduler, rate and selected hardware but no competing request/transfer and no intentional background load. Reset caches before each solo. This defines interference-free action-matched normalization; for B under no-migration use a solo remote action, not solo repair.
solo_counterfactuals.timing_use: Solo outcomes are analysis-only labels and cannot alter offered work, scheduling thresholds or methods. They are not online policy features. Keep the solo/group pair in one input block and disclose sequential timing drift.
solo_counterfactuals.order: Precompute balanced random solo-before-group versus group-before-solo order within each method/block, and randomized order among B solo runs. Freeze before results. Duplicate geometries are still new measured trials, not additional independent statistical blocks.
solo_counterfactuals.transfer_solo: The isolation module also needs one actual unopposed prefix transfer per I-cell/method/input-block for the five migration methods, including warmup. This is separate from decoded-request solo counts and has its own readiness/bytes/cleanup evidence; no-migration has no such service.
solo_counterfactuals.fairness: Use action-matched request completion/TTFT/mean-ITL slowdown ratios and the complete per-request vector. Jain's index may be reported on reciprocal completion slowdowns only within a fixed group composition; accompany it with worst slowdown, absolute latencies, makespan and failures. Equal severe slowdown can give Jain=1 and is not useful-service success.

inputs_repetition_and_order.training: No E4 learned selector or outcome-tuned parameters. The fixed algorithms need no E4 train/calibration split. E1/E2/E3 predictors are not refit or consulted to choose E4 winners.

service_calibration.purpose: Set only the fixed rho0.5 background arrival rate; record both service and request wall time. Same fixed procedure as E1. Calibration cannot select cells, scheduler weights or aging thresholds.

inputs_repetition_and_order.input_freeze: Materialize all tokenizer arrays and content hashes before timings. A/B role suffixes and distinct prefix identities are derived reproducibly within each family; no overlaps with prior stages' train/cal/test/smoke/profile families. Cross-method pairing is exact; cells and multiple requests of a family are dependent observations.
inputs_repetition_and_order.method_order: Randomize method and cell orders deterministically, balance early/late positions across eight blocks, and retain the complete frozen order. Do not always run the candidate last or rerun only unfavorable competitors. Warmups are excluded but fully audited.
inputs_repetition_and_order.background_seed: Derive from block+cell+load host, not method. Log actual generated offers and local acceptance anchors. Differences caused by execution duration are endogenous and must be reported rather than masked by truncation.

timing_traffic_and_instrumentation.source_clock: Record source-local RPC receive, ready-compute enqueue/admit/complete, frame-ready/send start/end, transfer terminal and receiver-drain ACK. Use only within-host differences or explicit ping/ACK brackets; never subtract source and destination monotonic clocks.
request_metrics: mean and maximum ITL per request
request slowdown relative to paired actual solo
group makespan and generated tokens per measured group second
transfer_metrics: first actual send and first GPU-ready layer
complete GPU-ready prefix and drained settlement time
bytes/grants during foreground-active and total intervals
unserved migration if aborted or timed out
bulk queue age and longest interval without a grant while eligible
timing_traffic_and_instrumentation.queue_metrics: Per-request RPC queue wait, pacing wait and source/destination ready-compute queue wait/service. Queue service ends after actual CUDA stream completion but remains host-wall service, not kernel time. Record peak and duration-weighted ready queue lengths; distinguish queued work, active work and I/O waits.
timing_traffic_and_instrumentation.bottleneck_evidence: For each direction record shared coordinator identity, all stream IDs/classes, cumulative successful send/receive bytes and reservation totals, class backlog and successful-byte deltas in fixed100ms local bins. In separate profiles retain full ordered grants and CUDA traces. A shared cap or high total byte count alone does not establish concurrent contention: require actual coexisting eligible RPC/bulk plus waiting and grant/serialization evidence.
timing_traffic_and_instrumentation.application_bytes: Count framing/header/payload/control/RPC/bulk/terminal/drain bytes across every connection, including failures and group setup/settlement. Reconcile successful source sends with destination receives in each direction after complete drain; reserved bytes are not wire bytes. Main data never transports full-vocabulary logits.
timing_traffic_and_instrumentation.physical_wire_bytes: Null/unavailable unless a separately reviewed experiment-flow counter or capture measures them, including encapsulation/retransmits with explicit scope. Interface-wide byte counters cannot be silently assigned to this experiment. Application goodput and cap utilization must be named accordingly.
timing_traffic_and_instrumentation.overhead: Main instrumentation uses bounded counters and per-request timing records, not full per-chunk history, tensor hashes, NVTX or profiler queries. Historical recent_grants(maxlen256) cannot prove an entire trial's schedule. Separate profiles supply complete traces. Measure counter-only versus profiled overhead on excluded fixtures and never use profiled latency as a main result.
timing_traffic_and_instrumentation.GPU_utilization: Report coarse utilization as sampled telemetry with sample cadence and missingness, not as proof of kernel overlap. Nsight CUDA activity/copy events provide mechanism attribution in the declared separate profiles.

correctness_and_failure_contract.every_candidate: Every group, decoded-request solo and transfer solo executes real work. Every decoded request has a separate exact-route diagnostic and same-shape HF reference with the original strict finite/full-vocabulary/greedy/cache-position tests. Transfer-only jobs require actual source/destination immutable KV content equality in the separate diagnostic and complete readiness/byte/ownership checks in main.
correctness_and_failure_contract.concurrent_replay: Replay each request's recorded per-layer cutovers/actions and audit actual source RPC positions. A diagnostic need not reproduce main physical thread interleaving or queue times; do not assert that it does. Both endpoints and all request identities must be bound to the same frozen group plan.
correctness_and_failure_contract.no_main_audit_perturbation: No main-path full-vocabulary transport, per-checkpoint GPU-to-CPU cache hashing, extra source witness RPC or synchronous per-kernel profiling solely for evidence. Required operational control and its cost remain real.
correctness_and_failure_contract.all_offered_denominator: Preserve every offered request/transfer/background job, including admission failure, timeout, cancellation and late completion. Report group and request failures before any successful-only latency panel. Never erase a slow or failed competing request when reporting foreground benefit.
correctness_and_failure_contract.timeout: Predeclare finite group and solo deadlines from the actual new E4 smoke plus resource review before full freeze; no unbounded migration wait or infinite starvation run. Failure to finish is censored/incomplete work, not zero migration time, and forbids a complete paired-comparison claim. An attempt deadline cannot be lengthened selectively after observing a losing method.
correctness_and_failure_contract.cleanup: Close all owned control/RPC/bulk sockets, drain or terminate owned threads, release request/prefix references, restore network rules and confirm selected GPUs have no owned stale child. A passed numeric record with failed cleanup is not an accepted group.
correctness_and_failure_contract.retry: Infrastructure retries use a new immutable attempt ID, preserve the failed attempt and repeat the declared complete pair/block as needed after diagnosis. No silent method deletion or tolerance change.

statistics_and_reporting.units: Eight held-out input/seed blocks. Methods are paired; multiple cells, concurrent requests, tokens and retries inside a block are not independent samples.

bootstrap.resampling: Resample whole blocks jointly across methods/cells, preserving request and solo pairings. Report individual block points and intervals; eight blocks do not provide a power guarantee.

endpoints: A mean ITL and token-completion time
primary_contrasts.purpose: Isolate transport/copy interference without B decode.

endpoints: migration progress and bulk starvation intervals
primary_contrasts.purpose: Expose foreground protection versus fairness costs under three genuine competing requests.

statistics_and_reporting.secondary: Report all12 cells and all6 methods without selecting favorable regions. Coarse/fine FIFO isolates chunking; C03/L01/L03 separates network scheduling from holder/destination compute contention. Negative gains and natural transfer completion remain in tables.
statistics_and_reporting.tie_rule: Within5% of the paired primary completion or mean-ITL endpoint is a predeclared practical tie, shown with raw differences and intervals. The threshold is descriptive, not a significance test or forced winner assignment.
statistics_and_reporting.tradeoff_rule: Do not call a method better solely because A improves. Show the vector of foreground latency, each B slowdown, transfer completion and makespan. A result may be Pareto-incomparable. No-migration reference is excluded from equal-migration-service Pareto rankings.
statistics_and_reporting.tail_scope: Maximum and any descriptive empirical within-request quantile must show the actual count of63 ITLs and its correlated-request scope. No request p95/p99, tail-probability confidence or steady-state SLO guarantee is reported from these eight blocks.
statistics_and_reporting.goodput_scope: Report completed generated tokens and successful offered requests per observed finite-group wall time, with failures and unfinished transfer work separate. This is finite-trace throughput, not production SLO goodput. Do not import favorable SLO thresholds after seeing these data.
statistics_and_reporting.needed_for_tail_and_joint_SLO_claims: A separate preregistered open-loop arrival workload with explicit TTFT/ITL and migration/deadline objectives, all offered denominators, independently chosen thresholds, representative prompt/reuse distribution and enough independent blocks/requests is required. A nominal1000 requests is only a starting plan, not automatic tail precision; sample size must follow desired interval precision and dependence. This belongs to the expanded workload/E7 study and is not fabricated here.

smoke_plan.purpose: Functional coverage and capacity/deadline calibration only; no fitted scheduler, publication timing or test-family selection.
smoke_plan.methods: All six declared methods for each selected cell:24 group smoke attempts, using the excluded smoke family.
acceptance: All four concurrent requests and real rho0.5 load fit the main14B GPU memory budget
Actual queued RPC and bulk overlap exists in I02/C02; a no-contention run is not labeled as a priority-path test
Coarse/fine chunks and each scheduler are observed, with fixed-weight deficit and aging override actually triggered at least once on declared fixtures
Strict RPC priority may yield valid negative/fairness outcomes; do not alter workloads to conceal them
All requests and transfer jobs pass independent numerical/content, both-endpoint byte and ownership checks
If no aging trigger occurs, a separately disclosed CPU/component functional fixture may test logic but cannot substitute for GPU mechanism evidence or mark the live path covered
smoke_plan.capacity_failure: Stop and review a versioned pre-execution revision; do not silently reduce concurrency/P, change dtype or use the second GPU.

separate_profiles.inputs: Excluded profile family, fixed before main outcomes; profile every listed cell/method once, not selected winners.
separate_profiles.required: Freeze raw Nsight report and SQLite hashes on both actual hosts; reanalyze source and destination CUDA compute/copies, queue admissions and complete chunk-grant/control timeline. Bind traces to model/source/plan/request IDs and actual cap. Preserve valid negative overlap/priority effects instead of forcing positives.
separate_profiles.interpretation: Profiles attribute mechanisms and test timing-accounting consistency. They are not extra independent statistical repetitions and do not replace uninstrumented main measurements.

resources_and_counts.background_arrival_counts: Data dependent because actual Poisson producer runs through each group; record every offered background request and drain. These are not additional independent test blocks and are not included in the fixed decoded-request count.
resources_and_counts.CPU_resources: Two worker CPU threads per selected GPU, real request/transport threads and orchestration processes; record actual CPU allocation/affinity and utilization. CPU-only preparation generates plans, checks evidence, and computes paired statistics. No third GPU or host is assumed.
resources_and_counts.estimate_formula: Before full freeze use actual accepted E4 smoke costs: T_session = setup + sum main(group/solo/transfer) times + sum separate diagnostics and HF reference times + reset/drain times +16 profile attempts + independent-audit time. Report component sample counts/ranges and assumptions; do not extrapolate E0 or E1 single-request seconds as measured E4 cost.
resources_and_counts.GPU_hours_formula: Sum actual selected-GPU ownership seconds across both hosts divided by3600, including initialization, diagnostics, solo references, background drain and profiling. Do not multiply CPU-only post-hoc audit time by two GPUs unless the allocation really remains owned. Kernel-active time is a separate profiled quantity.
resources_and_counts.scope_limit: Two hosts suffice for this shared-link/application-scheduler mechanism study. Independent competing holders or paths need at least three physical hosts and a new topology-controlled protocol.

implementation_gaps.gap: Expose per-trial finite chunk size and the fixed weighted/aging schedulers while retaining one shared budget for all streams in each direction.
implementation_gaps.existing: SharedBandwidthCoordinator implements fifo/rpc_first with default16KiB and records only the last256 grants; this is not the proposed full scheduler/instrumentation API.

implementation_gaps.gap: Build source-bound multi-request full runner and a real transfer-only immutable KV job, with per-request accepted/last-token/settled times and all-offered accounting.
implementation_gaps.existing: Old campaign can run concurrent remote+repair but lacks this complete full-stage timing, solo counterfactual and statistical protocol.

implementation_gaps.gap: Integrate one common ready-compute queue for all A/B/background work and validate four-request main-model capacity before freezing full.
implementation_gaps.existing: E1 queue/background implementation is available but E1's one foreground request does not establish new multi-request integration correctness.

implementation_gaps.gap: Add complete both-direction final byte reconciliation and counter-only queue/bottleneck records; optional physical-wire measurement requires separately reviewed flow attribution.
implementation_gaps.existing: Application socket bytes exist; physical_wire_bytes remains unavailable and historical recent-grant history is truncated.

implementation_gaps.gap: Implement separate concurrent exact-route diagnostics, actual transfer content checks, matched solo runs and independent raw coverage/identity/timing/cleanup audit.
implementation_gaps.existing: Reuse accepted mathematical kernels and precision tolerances but do not assume E1 single-request acceptance proves this concurrent path.

implementation_gaps.gap: Collect16 source-bound paired Nsight profiles and analyze queue/grant/copy/compute attribution without moving profile overhead into main timings.
implementation_gaps.existing: E0/E1 profiling tools are reusable; their old traces are not E4 evidence.

implementation_gaps.gap: Representative open-loop workload, explicit SLOs, statistically justified tails and independent multi-path topology.
implementation_gaps.existing: Explicit future extension; not hidden behind this mechanism-stage completion flag.

completion_criteria: Prior stages and new E4 smoke accepted by immutable source/model/physical-cohort evidence; no stage leap.
Frozen12-cell/6-method/8-block matrix, excluded warmups, all paired actual solos and diagnostic/reference counts reconcile exactly; all offered failures retained.

At least the preregistered slow isolation/coupled cells demonstrate actual competing RPC/bulk eligibility, waits and service under one measured shared budget. Unsupported claims about an unobserved bottleneck remain withheld.
All request numerics, actual routes, transfer contents/readiness, both-endpoint bytes and cache/thread/socket/network cleanup gates pass without weakened tolerances.

Foreground gains or losses, every competing request's slowdown, migration delay/starvation and finite-group resource use are reported together; no favorable-only selection or no-migration service substitution.
Independent audit verifies all raw hashes plus the32 endpoint traces and rereads profile analyses; valid negative results are retained.

A reviewer records precisely the accepted mechanism scope and remaining tail/SLO/topology gaps. Neither this JSON nor a passed execution summary automatically sets E4_complete or paper_stage_complete.
